faceset_archive_audit.container_format_description: FaceSet .fsz archives are ZIP containers storing canonical cropped PNG facial imagery and optional structured metadata.json.

format_evolution.legacy_v1: Sequential PNG files (0.png, 1.png, ...) stored uncompressed (ZIP Store method 0). Embedding extraction and pose estimation computed dynamically on load.
format_evolution.v2_additive: ZIP Deflate container containing version 2 metadata.json and indexed PNG crops. Embeddings (512-d normalized floats), 3D head poses (yaw/pitch/roll), pose matrix bins (frontal/profile/pitch), dermal patch frequency analysis, and source quality scores precomputed and stored.

readers_writers_code_sites: app/roop/FaceSet.py (FaceSet class, pose-matched embedding lookup, 3D face bank attributes face_3d, face_3d_bank)
app/roop/faceset_v2.py (read_faceset_archive, build_faceset_v2, metadata validation, dermal patch, pose cells)
app/roop/faceset_manager.py (load_and_validate_faceset, memory caching, SHA-256 validation, library index)
app/routes_faceset.py (FastAPI REST handlers: list, save, load, rename, delete, import, thumbnail generation)
